title: Expired command leases recover without silent loss
description:
As an operator, I want interrupted commands to become recoverable after their execution lease expires, so that worker failure cannot silently lose long-running work.

Feature: Recover interrupted commands
  Scenario: A worker disappears during execution
    Given a running command with a renewable execution lease
    And the worker stops heartbeating before completion
    When the lease expires
    Then the command becomes eligible for a controlled retry
    And a stale worker cannot complete the superseded attempt
    And the task history records the interruption and retry

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Additional behavior for this slice:

Feature: Maintain ownership during long execution
  Scenario: A healthy worker continues a long-running command
    Given a worker holds an active command lease
    When the configured heartbeat interval elapses during execution
    Then the lifecycle lease is renewed before its expiry
    And the broker delivery lease is extended
    And completion uses the latest fencing token

  Scenario: A worker loses its execution lease
    Given a worker is executing a command
    And another attempt supersedes its lease
    When its next heartbeat is rejected
    Then the stale worker is notified that ownership was lost
    And it cannot report progress, complete, or acknowledge the delivery
